social.text: Off-centre composition 🎬 Placing your subject away from the middle of the frame adds visual interest. The empty side becomes negative space, and it can say a lot: where a character is looking, where they’re heading, or how isolated they feel. Leave space in the direction they face (lead room) and the frame feels natural. Cut it short on purpose and it feels tense. # Cinematography # Filmmaking # Composition # RuleOfThirds # NegativeSpace
